_about: One model for every number (Hanli, 2026-10-15; design.md § Pacing and the economy). The rules read these through content.mjs (withBalance) — the 层 thresholds onto the ladder, the pay tables onto rewards, the cooldowns onto the 饭桶 and 兽潮 — and tools/balance.mjs simulates a light, a typical and a heavy player on them, day by day, printing days per 回; tests/balance.test.mjs holds the bands. Change a number here, run `node tools/balance.mjs`, and hand-play it on the live page.
_master: 数值系统 phase 2 (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「数值系统继续做吧」; design.md § 数值系统): the knobs. Everything this table derives — `layers`, `play_pay`'s hours · games · errand · wall · chore · seclusion, `pills`, the `pill` and `seclusion` pay caps, `convert`, `economy` (I(L)), the pay tables' `ls`, `boards`, `play_pay.wealth`, the 圆满 share, `kailu.tier`, `breakthrough`, every pill's effect at its level (`pills.effects`) and every `buy` and `sell` (batch 2) — is written by `node tools/numbers.mjs --apply --write` (a dry-run diff without --write), never by hand; a number that must not follow its formula is an `overrides` row. tests/numbers.test.mjs holds the dry run empty. Every 修为 pay is a share of the layer (play_pay), so `need` is the numbers he reads, not the pace: the pace is `hours`, the shares, the model's minutes and the book's length. A line is a ladder of its own (Hanli 10-27: 古 · 今 · 未来 each their own 修为 and realms): `lines.gu` is built; 今 and 未来 get their rows, with their own pace, when their pay is.

events._about: 冷却事件 (rules/events.mjs; 2026-10-28, the coordinator for Hanli): what one completion of an event pays, in plays of its table. `yaoshou.batch_plays`: a whole batch of 妖兽出没 pays as one fight (one 兽潮 night pays one fight's worth too, on the same haunt table), so each fight in it pays `events.yaoshou.fight_scale` = batch_plays ÷ batch (tools/master.mjs derive; node tools/numbers.mjs --apply).

xiuwei._about: 修为 is a fixed number (Hanli 2026-11-02: 「不要按照百分比给.... 给太多了」 · 「我是说参考百分比的数值. 不能直接给百分比」 — supersedes 10-27's 「按照百分比奖励」; the formula, approved in principle: 「这套公式基本可以, 先记下来, 以后在调整吧」). Levels: L = realm × 9 + 层, 81 of them (Hanli 2026-11-10; 段 display only — rules/playpay.mjs levelOf). Every grant the book makes is a size in `units` × R where it is paid (2026-11-10: 「所有和数值相关的都应该有公式推到, 不能手动定」), the one hand-written number a `told` below. `rate`: R(L) = base × growth^(L−1), × `realm` a realm up — the 修为 one 体力 of play is worth at content level L (R base 2 is xw_per_stamina: a board's 3 体力 → 6, a fight's 4 → 8, 兽潮's 5 → 10). A reward = R(content level) × 体力 cost × `difficulty` (normal · elite · boss/副本; `first_clear` +50%) × ★ (play_pay.stars) × `gap` (−`below` a level he stands above it, to `floor`; +`above` a level he stands below it, to +`cap`) × the replay (play_pay.replay) × 灵根 · 签 · 宜 (rules/playpay.mjs xiuweiOf, core.mjs amountsOf). `units`: what has no 体力 of its own, in 体力-units at the same R — 人间功课 a day 10 (20 修为 at 练气一层; 5 until 2026-11-10's doubling of the app-linked chores), a week 20, a month 30; a day's east-wall tags 5 together; a night's 闭关 10 (20 at 练气一层; 23.5 until 2026-11-10, when the games took the layer back: a 一转 聚气丹's 「抵小半日打坐」 holds, both riding R). `board` · `fight`: see `_board`. The content level is where he stands unless the thing declares its own (`level`). % of the layer is the reference only (tools/numbers.mjs). Open: above 筑基 a step is slow by S — retuned with 卷二.
xiuwei._board: `board` · `fight` (Hanli 2026-11-10: 「把小游戏奖励修为提高到1.5呗」, then the same evening 「打一场才几点, 感觉不太匹配」 — the games carry the layer again): a small game's play (a board, a 秘境 room, a 兽潮 night, a 切磋 bout, a story step) × `board`, a card fight's × `fight`, on R × 体力; nothing else rides them (闭关, 功课, errands, pills are their own units). Raised 1.5 → 5 (and the fight's 1 → 5, the same per minute as a board) with 闭关's night 23.5 → 10 units, so the typical player's small games and fights carry about 60% of a 练气 layer, errands about 15%, 闭关 + 功课 the rest (tools/balance.mjs ledger by layer; the 11-10 report). need(L) carries `board` through the mix, so the pace is T₁'s (re-solved).
xiuwei._classes: The largest size an authored one-off of each class may declare (Hanli 2026-11-10: a rule red on designed things is noise — tools/numbers.mjs sources): `scene` a scene's way on (卷二–卷八's cauldrons' 30), `board` a board's own grant (炼丹's 10), `errand` an errand's (凫丽山's red tag, 30), `item` a thing's, `gongke` a 人间功课 meaning (练功's 6 since its doubling), `trial` a 抉择 win, `mark` an 对子 mark or the 签's 应验 — in units; `pill_nights` a pill outside the families (筑基丹 …) in nights of 闭关, the 九转's 3. `share_games` a chore's own pay in small games (传音's 3, Hanli 2026-11-10 「传音改成真正的3倍」: a deliberate source above the ordinary chore, outside per_day and shares_per_day). Red when one declares more. The designed sources (a night's 闭关, the 功课's periods, a day's wall, the sized tables, a family pill by its 转) are weighed against their own declared size instead: red only if the rules pay more.
xiuwei._told: The one 修为 number written by hand (Hanli 2026-11-10: 「所有和数值相关的都应该有公式推到, 不能手动定」 — every other grant is a size in `units` × R at the layer it is paid on): keyed `<scene>/<exit>`, its `progress` paid as written where that exit's grant says `told: true` (content.mjs toldOf), each with its why. tools/numbers.mjs reports it against a story step's pay both ways.

wm-mingpai/over.why: Hanli's own call (2026-11-09, kept 2026-11-10): the first night in the 石室, which the book tells as the gain (wm-kaikai: 「第一天夜里，二层圆满，跟着第三层的关口在他身子里「咯」地一响」) — the 秘境's buried-earth night he named as the one exception to 「不要白给修为, 除了像秘境埋土里那次, 剧情里明确写了突破的」. Kept as written; a story step there would pay one small game's (the report shows both).

gu._about: 古's ladder (ladder.json tiers: 练气 九层 from 零层, then eight realms of nine 层, each shown in three 段): 81 levels on the curve (2026-11-10, tools/master.mjs curveOf) — `time` T(L) a layer's hours of play, `need` its threshold = R(L) × mix × 60 × T(L) (rounded to `need.round`), mix = master.xiuwei.board × games.time ÷ games.share. Until 2026-11-10 `need` was its own hand curve (练气一层 470 ×1.1 a layer, ×1.3 a realm, 段 split) and `hours` a reference fitted per 回. `solve`: the rule `time.first` is solved by (tools/balance.mjs --solve). 2026-11-10 solve (batch 1): T₁ = 3.567 h (need(1) 370). Re-solved the same evening once the games carry the layer (`board` 1.5 → 5, a fight × 5, 闭关's night 23.5 → 10, the app-linked 功课 doubled), each 回 judged on its own band (古八 on its `bands.except` row): T₁ = 1.564 h (need(1) 550); 古四 · 古五 · 古七 · 古八 move with it (古七 7.0 and 古八 12.5 typical bind), 古六 (h08) is left out — its days do not move with T₁ (6 → 6). `range` from 0.5 h: a layer is fewer hours of play now that a minute of the mix pays more.
gu._time: T(L) = first × growth^(L−1): a layer's hours of play (no step at a realm), and need(L) = R(L) × mix × 60 × T(L) (tools/master.mjs curveOf; mix = board × games.time ÷ games.share = 2.917 units a minute on 古 since 2026-11-10 evening (board 5; 0.875 at 1.5)). `first` is solved, never picked: node tools/balance.mjs --solve (the solve's rule in `solve`).

jin._about: 今's ladder (ladder.json `lines.jin`: 新生 九层 from 一层, three steps a realm above; Hanli 2026-10-27, each line its own 修为, starting from zero). Its only 修为 is its boards (no fights, errands, 功课, 闭关 or pills on 今 yet; 人间功课 pays 古): `games` carries the whole layer (`share` 1) over about half its minutes (`time`, the rest is reading). `need`: 新生一层 300, the same steps as 古's (display only: pay is a share of the layer). `hours`: the curve (新生一层 1 h, +0.25 h a layer), then fitted (`fit`, tools/master.mjs fitLine) so a reader of 卷一 who plays every 今 board at `stars` ends `end` layers up: 1.4 is 新生一层 filled and 二层 four tenths (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「今线修为可以开始做了」, the interludes about 一层 → 二层). 2026-11-02 (agent's pick, Hanli approved: fixed pay): a 今 board pays its 体力 × R like any (6 at 新生一层), so `need.first` 300 → 80 keeps 卷一's 今 at 新生一层 into 二层 (the fit's `end` 1.4). 2026-11-04: → 50, as a 今 对话 board went from 3 体力 to its measured 1 (play_pay.minutes): 卷一 still ends 1.42 layers up. 2026-11-10 (the curve): its `need` is the same curve on its own `time.first` (mix = board × 0.5 ÷ 1 = 0.75 units a minute), solved so a reader of 卷一 at `solve.stars` ends `solve.end` layers up — 1.967, where the old ladder had him on 2026-11-10 after a small game's ×1.5 (tools/balance.mjs --solve: T₁ 0.583 h, need(1) 52, 卷一 ends 1.982 up; re-solved the same evening at `board` 5 — mix 2.5 units a minute: T₁ 0.572 h, need(1) 172, 卷一 ends 1.967 up); `need.round` 1 (at 10 its first 层 would ask the same).

pills._about: 丹药 by family (batch 2, Hanli 2026-11-10: 「丹药, 物品都给一个级别吧」 · 「回春族按你说的改，筑基丹份额高一档」): every pill has its `level` (items.json) and its numbers are its level's, never where he eats it — a low pill stays what it is (the old `below` share is gone). A 修为 family pays share[转] × need(its level) (the 层 threshold there; tools/master.mjs pillsOf, folded at load as units at R of its level); `share` by 转 (named 转 between them straight, as before). 聚气 (`qi`) is today's nights of 闭关 re-expressed at 练气一层 (0.3 · 0.8 · 1.6 · 3 nights × a night's 20 ÷ 550), so its cards' 「抵小半日 · 抵三日」 hold at its level. 筑基 (`foundation`) and 固基 (`firm`) are 聚气's × `step` 1.5 (Hanli's 「高一档」; ×2 the candidate beside it, the 11-10 report). 回春 (`mend`) heals in a fight: share × his 气血 at its level (rules/cards.mjs hpMaxOf); 回气 (`huiqi`) share × his 灵力 cap there. 修为 comes only from the 修为 families; `xian` a 仙丹's share (its 阶 off the ladder, no 转). `exceptions`: a pill that pays beside its family, each with its why.

mend-pill-9.why: The book (its card): 「骨伤也治得好，修为也跟着涨一截」 — the 九转回春丹 mends and lifts cultivation a little: two nights of 闭关 at its level (40 修为 at 练气一层; 九转聚气丹's 3, 「涨一截」 the smaller) beside its full heal; until 2026-11-10 it paid 3 nights and healed nothing. One night (20) moved the typical 古七 7.0 → 6.6 days and 古八 12.5 → 12.6 (it is eaten in 古四, wm-diyilu): two keep the pace as it was (tools/balance.mjs).

difficulty._about: The fight bands the bot (tools/story-fights.mjs, lookahead) is held to: a story fight's first meeting bare, a pool's beast; `slack` the deals' noise before a fight is red. A fight may name its own band (story-fights FIGHTS `band`).

fight._about: 斗法 on the level (batch 3, Hanli 2026-11-10: 「所有和数值相关的都应该有公式推到, 不能手动定」 · 卡牌的整数不改 「可以，按你的想法来」): `power` P(L) = first × growth^(L−1) × realm^realm, the same shape as R(L) and I(L) (rules/power.mjs); `first` 21 is 练气一层's 气血 as it was. His 气血 at full is P(his level) (rules/cards.mjs hpMaxOf). A fight is reckoned in his units (battle.js § unitOf): his 气血 the anchor — his realm's first level as it was (练气 21, 筑基 26, 结丹 32, 元婴 40: a realm's length class, its fights that much longer); a beast's its class share (creatures.json `hp`, a pool entry's, a story fight's foe's or a 秘境 room's over it; × the mode's 0.7) of his realm's row × P(its level) ÷ P(his); every card number as it is. So a hero and a beast of one level fight the fight of 练气一层 (of his realm), turn for turn and rounding for rounding, whatever the level; a beast a level apart is P's ratio stronger or weaker in 气血 and in every blow (st.scale) and every amount weighed against 气血 (a body's 血, +血, a heal, a glance, a lift's 抗); 境界压制 (a realm apart, battle.js SUPPRESS) multiplies on top. The page, Yinyue's facts and the rules' results show every fight number × P(his level) ÷ the anchor (battle.js shown). 零层 (before 入门) has no level and keeps its numbers; a fight kept from before batch 3 (its setup has no level) finishes on the old ones. `length`: fight_length (rules/cards.mjs lengthRule) — the cap on a beast's 气血 is what a player of level L deals a round (`dpt.first` card points at 练气一层, + `dpt.per_level` a level — the road's hands) over the realm's length class, × the realm's rounds (`minutes` by realm, `sec_per_round`); `heals`, `carry` as before (balance.json `_fight_length`). `gear`: a worn thing's points by its slot and 品.
fight._things: `power.things`: where a worn thing's points (atk · def · ward, its 品 × the slot's class — master.gear) and a 回春丹's 气血 (master.pills, at the pill's level) count in a fight. 'own': at the thing's own level, × P(its level) ÷ P(his) — an arm of 练气一层 is a 练气一层 arm at 筑基; 'wearer': at his level, as before batch 3 (its level sets its price only). 'wearer' since 2026-11-10: every arm and heal pill 卷一 gives is 练气一层–七层, and 'own' takes the road's fights at 古六–第九回 out of their bands (cangying, dangkang, 冰夷双龙, the 冀 pools — doc/status.md § The numbers system, batch 3); 'own' wants 卷一 to sell or drop a 筑基 arm and pill first. Hanli's to choose.

gear._about: A worn thing's fight points by its slot and 品 (items.json `pin`, batch 3: no hand 攻 · 防 · 抗 in the book): a weapon's 攻 (主灵根一击 + 攻 × cards.json gear.weapon_power), a robe's or shoes' 防 (护体 × armor_per_def), a pendant's 抗 on each root it names (`wards`, × ward_per_point) — points = 品 × the slot's own. Prices are points × economy.prices.gear × I(its level) (batch 2). In a fight the points count where power.things says.

economy._about: 灵石 on one curve (batch 2, Hanli 2026-11-10: 「所有和数值相关的都应该有公式推到, 不能手动定」 · 「丹药, 物品都给一个级别吧, 算数值的时候, 按照这个级别算」): `income` I(L) = first × growth^(L−1) × realm^realm — the 灵石 a minute of play is worth at level L (L = realm × 9 + 层, 零层 read at L1), the same shape as R(L) (rules/playpay.mjs incomeAt). Every 灵石 the book grants is a size in minutes of income (`ls` on a grant, a table's, a board's rank, a kind's play) × I where it is paid (its `level` if it says one, else where he stands; rules/playpay.mjs stonesAt); every shop price is minutes × I(the item's own level) by its class (`prices`, tools/master.mjs pricesOf). `first` 2.5: the sizes are today's 灵石 × 0.3 (a minute at the old 3⅓), and I₁ is set so the typical player's 卷一 earns what it did on main (2380 — tools/balance.mjs --wealth; his 灵石 is earned mostly at 练气五–九层, where I(L) stands at 3.0–3.7): 练气一层 pays 0.75 of what it did, 七层 1.0, 九层 1.1, 筑基一层 1.4. Until 2026-11-10 `income` was a flat 3.2 and every grant a hand number.
economy._earn: 2026-11-12: 「目前灵石3.6K了, 没有消耗的地方, 奖励调低点」；1 为原收入。
economy._tables: What a pay table pays by itself, or the most a grant on it may declare (`pay.<table>.ls`, minutes of income): `labor` an errand of 杂役, `once` 开府, `stage` a 阶段任务 handed in, `chore_week` the 宗门月俸, `life` the day's pick, `gongke_zero` a 功课 at 零层, `haunt` a pool's fight won; the rest cap the book's grants (a scene's way on, a task's, a meet's…). Today's caps × 0.3.
economy._boards: A small game's first clear after 入门 (rules/tasks.mjs boardPay, Hanli 2026-10-16): plain · good · best, in minutes of income (5 · 10 · 15 灵石 until 2026-11-10).
economy._play: A board's play by its kind (play_pay.wealth, rules/playpay.mjs playGrant), minutes of income on the same ★ and replay as its 修为.
economy._errand: An errand's work and a wall tag (play_pay.errand.ls, rules/playpay.mjs errandGrant · wallGrant): minutes of income (15 灵石 until 2026-11-10).
economy._convert: 圆满 → 灵石 (rules/playpay.mjs convertRate): 修为 past the mark pays `convert_share` of a minute's income for each minute of small-game play it is worth — share × I(L) ÷ (R(L) × xiuwei.board); R and I share their shape, so 0.25 灵石 a 修为 at every level (0.333 until 2026-11-10).
economy._kailu: 开炉 (rules/fantong-roll.mjs worthOf): a thing no shop buys back is worth its 品阶's `kailu_tier` minutes × I(its level) to the pot — 8 · 25 · 70 · 200 灵石 until 2026-11-10, × 0.3, the top 品阶 (九转筑基丹 · 仙丹, levels 9–10) at 45 so it stands where its 200 did there; the pot's 灵石 rows (fantong.json `ls`) are minutes × I at the pot's own level (its highest thing's), and a pot reaches no thing above the realm after its own (`reach_level`) — so a pot of low things never pays a high level's worth: no farm (tools/numbers.mjs kailu rows). A grade's floor (`kailu_floor`: 3 · 12 · 40 灵石 until 2026-11-10, re-expressed at 练气一层's I — a pot of 凡物 is 练气一层's) is minutes × I at the pot's level too.
economy._prices: Every shop price: minutes of income × I(the item's level), by its class (tools/master.mjs pricesOf). A 修为 pill (a family's) costs `pill_ratio` × the minutes of small-game play its 修为 is worth there (R(L) × xiuwei.board a minute) — buying 修为 is never cheaper than playing for it (tools/numbers.mjs holds the row), and a player who spends every 灵石 on 聚气丹 gains little (10: 卷一's typical 44.5 days → 42.5 for one who does, tools/balance.mjs --qi-buy; at 2 it was 37.3, at 24 — main's 48 — 43.6); a pill a breakthrough reaches for (ladder breakthrough.pill.items) `breakthrough` minutes for each point it adds to the throw; a heal pill `heal` minutes a point of 气血, a mana pill `mana` a point of 灵力; gear `gear` minutes a point (攻 · 防 · 抗) by slot; a material its kind's (fantong.json kinds: herb · beast · ore · paper · else junk; a 天材 that binds an element `tiancai`) × `grade` by its 品阶 (fantong.json tiers, 0 凡物 … 4); a card's thing `card` by its kind (a treasure that carries it, a 玉简 that teaches it) × (its card's cost + 1), a 符 `charm` × its card's cost; a 功法卷 `scroll` × its 卷; a 储物袋 `pouch` a slot; a treasure, an artifact, a key their own. A shop buys back `sell_back` of its price (a third), where it buys back at all; 妖丹 `sell_back_of` — the beasts' trade goods (until 2026-11-10 three overrides at two thirds).
economy._told: The 灵石 numbers written by hand (scripts/content.mjs authoredStones: a numeric `wealth` anywhere in the book is an error but these), keyed by the path the lint prints, each with its why.

games.games.haggle.stage.why: The 游戏厅's 砍价 stage (games.json haggle `stage`) sets up a practice save that walks in with 300 灵石 to haggle with — a wallet he holds, never a grant paid; the arcade's fixture, not the economy.

economy._pouch: A 储物袋's room by its 品 (items.json `pin`: 1 下品 · 2 中品 · 3 上品 — the names say it): `base` × `step`^(品−1) slots, 6 · 12 · 24 as they were (batch 2; content.mjs withBalance folds it on). Its price is `prices.pouch` a slot × I(its level).

breakthrough._about: The breakthrough throw (rules/breakthrough.mjs; ladder.json breakthrough keeps which pills and elements, the numbers are here, folded onto it at load — batch 2, Hanli 2026-11-10). `base` by realm: 筑基 `first` (the book: about one in ten get through without a pill); from 结丹 `start` less `step` a realm, the realm after `plateau` (体修) standing level with the one before it — 55 · 50 · 45 · 40 · 40 · 35 · 30. A pill by its 转: `first` + `step` a 转 + `pin` more at each 品 (下 一–三 · 中 四–六 · 上 七–九) + `nine` more for a 九转 (near-certain) — 25 · 30 · 35 · 45 · 50 · 55 · 65 · 70 · 80. The rest as they were (ladder.json until 2026-11-10; tests/breakthrough-master.test.mjs holds the table it makes to the old one).

mijing._about: 秘境探险 (rules/mijing.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-28): the run's knobs, derived into `mijing` (tools/master.mjs mijingOf). `key`: a 秘境令's chance on a win in each cooldown event (兽潮 `shouchao` — a night, so about one a day; 比武切磋 `qiecuo`; 妖兽出没 `yaoshou`, a pool's beast won) under `cap_day` a day, so a day holds at most that many runs. `pay`: a run's 修为 is its minutes of rooms cleared at the games' rate (play_pay: the same per minute as any board, so a run never runs ahead of the pace) × `rate` (0.1 since 2026-10-31, when 古五's 二·三·四层 went to the 0.6 h floor — at 0.12 a day's two runs were 22% of those layers; 0.12 since 2026-10-28: a 练气 layer is about an hour of play, so a full-rate run was half a layer and the day's two a whole one — the run pays mostly in loot and 灵石; a day's two runs are about a tenth of a 练气 layer); a run not cleared pays `short` of it, and keeps its loot by the depth reached (`keep_min` at least). `hurt`: a board room's 气血 cost by its stars (a share of the run's), `yield` leaving one unplayed. `foe_step` · `td_step`: a 重 deeper, the foes' 气血 and the TD levels' difficulty. `wealth`: 灵石 in minutes of the typical income (economy.income) — a room won `room`, a chest `chest`, a clear `clear` — each 重 deeper `step` more. `clear.items`: the pills a clear pays (by 重, `from` · `to`); an arm and the 大妖's card come from the drop table and the beast.

_overrides: Numbers that do not follow their formula, each with its reason; --apply lays them on last and the 数值 page lists them. None since 2026-11-10 (batch 2): the 妖丹's two-thirds buy-back is master.economy.sell_back_of, with its why there.
_layers: The progress each step asks, by tier (ladder.json names the steps). 练气 counts from 零层 (0). Derived from the master table since 2026-10-27 (master.lines.gu.need: 练气一层 470, ×1.1 a layer, ×1.3 into the next realm; node tools/numbers.mjs --apply) — display only: every pay is a share of the layer. Before: fitted by balance.mjs --fit (retired).
_overflow_stretch: Hanli, 2026-10-15 (approved): a step up — the story's rise, a throw, or grinding the 回's cap allows — carries the 修为 over the last mark in whole, and the new step asks this share of it more (state.mjs stepUp, `state.stretch`): 100 over 一层's mark enters 二层 at 100/450, not 0/400. Grinders stay only somewhat ahead; nothing is held or lost.
_pay: Batch 2 (2026-11-10): a table's 灵石 is `ls`, minutes of income (master.economy.tables) — what the table pays by itself (labor, once, stage, chore_week, life, gongke_zero, haunt) or the most a grant on it may declare, × I where it is paid (rules/playpay.mjs stonesAt, tableStones); the `wealth` numbers below are history. What each kind of thing pays at most (修为 `progress`, 灵石 `wealth`); a grant is capped by its table (rules/core.mjs pay). Was rewards.json `tables`. Hanli, 2026-10-15 (「让游戏修为和故事match」): 修为 comes from cultivation; chores pay 灵石. `labor` pays an errand of 杂役 (修为 0, design.md § Pacing), `gongke` the day's 功课 (the fixed real-life chore, 修为 20), `life` the day's pick (灵石 only), `once` 开府 (灵石 only). A natural day of 卷一 play is now ~138 修为 (功课 20, two pool fights 60, half a rumor ~38, a road-meet 20) and the 练气 thresholds ask a 回 of it per held layer (tools/xiuwei-model.mjs). The 2026-09-24 note below is history. 2026-10-16 (灵石 buys pills, and cards and gear after): a fight won at a haunt pays 15 灵石 (was 10); 功课 stays 修为 — a typical day ~49 in, ~36 to pills, a few hundred left at 卷一's end (tools/balance.mjs --wealth). 2026-10-22 (人间功课 as cultivation, worlds/jiuding/gongke.json): `chore_kind` caps what a chore's meaning adds on top of its own pay, `chore_week` the 宗门月俸. 2026-10-27: `gongke` and `life` pay a share of the layer (play_pay.chore: a day's 10%, a week's 20%) — their `progress` here is no cap any more; `haunt` pays its minutes of play (play_pay.fight), the rest as authored, read against 练气一层 (play_pay.authored). 2026-11-02 (the new 开府): `once` pays the row's own `reward` — 50 灵石 — capped here at 50, and its `stamina` 20; the card says both. `story` (Hanli 2026-11-09: 「剧情可以给修为, 但要给的和玩一场小游戏差不多, 然后有动画显示剧情奖励」 · 「不要白给修为, 除了像秘境埋土里那次, 剧情里明确写了突破的」): a story step's 修为 is one small game's worth where he stands (rules/playpay.mjs storyPlay: `play_pay.story.units` 体力 × R — 8 at 练气七层), never an authored number; its 灵石 as authored, capped at 20 (the old `scene`). `gate`: a larger story gain, allowed only where the scene tells it — the exit's `narrated: {line, scene?}` quotes the line, and content.mjs lintEarned finds it in that scene's text (wm-mingpai → wm-kaikai's 埋土 night, 09-shenshi 「那年冬天，他过了八层」, 09-yanceng 「九层圆满，他已经到了」); the table caps nothing. History: 2026-11-02's `gate` lumps on every way into a 圆满 gate (wm-yaoyuan 210 · 09-suifeng 430 · 09-nianyao 500 · 09-dabi 570, untold) became `story` pays 2026-11-09; saves keep what they were paid.
_pay_stage: `stage` pays a 阶段任务 handed in (rules/gates.mjs stageTurn, Hanli 2026-10-16: 「七层圆满的任务大成了应该可以交任务拿奖励」). At 圆满 the 修为 cannot rise, so it pays 灵石: 60, three scenes' pay (`scene` 20) — about three days of the 回's 杂役 and 开府 — once per gate, never again; a gate crossed before stage quests paid is settled once on the next load (settleStages).
_convert: 修为不要超过上限, 超过后换算为灵石奖励 (Hanli, 2026-11-12; first for the fights' tables, 2026-10-15): every pay lands 修为 only up to the cap (rules/cap.mjs landProgress — the layer's need, or a share mark); the rest is paid as 灵石 at `share` × I(L) ÷ (R(L) × board) a 修为 (rules/playpay.mjs convertRate, master.economy.convert_share; 0.25 at every level today), rounded, at least 1 for any excess (cap.mjs overStones). It never carries into the next layer and never waits in the 丹田 (`banked`, gone 2026-11-12).
_kailu: 开炉's worth (rules/fantong-roll.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-27: 扔草药出丹, 扔物品出装备, 其他出符): what a thing is worth to the 饭桶 — its shop `sell` (prices below), else its 品阶's `tier` (fantong.json `tiers`); a 灵石 fed is worth `lingshi`. The grade rolled asks for an output worth the pot's worth × `x`, at least `floor` — 凡 a little under what went in, 有用 about it, 珍品 and 逆天 well over — so a pot of junk always gives something, a pot of good things gives about their worth back and the bucket is no farm. A row's chance falls off with how far its worth stands from that (log scale, `spread`), and nothing past `reach` times either way is drawn. `band`: what tools/numbers.mjs holds a pot's average return to (what comes out ÷ what went in) for the families' sample pots.
_prices: Every shop price, one source: `buy` what a shop asks, `sell` what it gives back — folded onto items.json by content.mjs withBalance, so no item carries its own. Derived (batch 2, 2026-11-10): minutes of income by the thing's class × I(its level) (master.economy.prices, tools/master.mjs pricesOf); a row's shape is the declaration — `buy` 0 (no shop sells it), `sell` 0 or none (no shop buys it back).
_boards: Hanli 2026-10-16: a small game after 入门 pays 灵石 on its first clear only — plain · good · best (or all three 灵光), in minutes of income × I where he stands (master.economy.boards, batch 2; 5 · 10 · 15 灵石 until 2026-11-10); a replay pays nothing. Before 入门 nothing is paid (state.mjs lockedOf shuts wealth). The rank: a task's `ranks` names it outright; else three stars is best, and of the listed marks the first (the clean clear) is best, the last plain, one between good; a board with no marks (洛书门, 小周天, the 今 boards) pays plain. On top of the task's own grant (rules/tasks.mjs boardPay).
_cooldowns: (The pools of 后山 · 上山路 are 妖兽出没's since 2026-10-28: they come in batches, `events.yaoshou`, never by these two.) `pool_rest_min`: a pool rests that long before the next beast stands — only after `pool_rest_after` wins in a row (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「后山的怪可以加多谢么? 或者做成打不完的」: never after every fight; a pool may say its own `rest` and `rest_after`; world.mjs poolResting). A beast beaten again the same day pays play_pay.replay's falling share. `fantong_min`: after a feed the 饭桶 is full that long (rules/fantong.mjs). (兽潮's cooldown is `events.shouchao` since 2026-10-31.)
_events: 冷却事件 (Hanli 2026-10-28: 「按你说的来」; rules/events.mjs): exactly three, each on a fun 主力 game — 兽潮 (塔防, rules/shouchao.mjs), 比武切磋 (格斗, after 宗门大比), 妖兽出没 (斗法). Shared: the cooldown `every_h` runs from completion (won, lost or skipped); a waiting event waits and never stacks; announced once (the tray or the 主页), never nudged; the day's first `full` pay in full, then play_pay.replay's falling share (the third half, the rest a tenth). `yaoshou` (rules/yaoshou.mjs; replacing `pool_rest_*` at these pools): the pools of 后山 · 上山路 (`pools`) hold a batch of `batch` fights; each fight settled there takes one, the last completes it; `yaoshou skip` lets a batch go (the clock starts, the day's count of batches paid in full does not move). A fight's pay keeps the beast's own replay share (play_pay.replay by beast), × the batch's day share, × `fight_scale` (derived from master.events.yaoshou.batch_plays: a whole batch pays as one fight, about one 兽潮 night). `title`, `open`, `shut`: the world's words for it.

shouchao._about: 兽潮 (rules/shouchao.mjs; 2026-10-26 a cooldown in place of the 酉时 window, an hour since 2026-10-28, Hanli: 「兽潮好玩」 · 「改成1小时一次也行」): a night comes again `every_h` after the last was counted; the day's first `full` nights pay in full, then play_pay.replay's share — the tide every hour is no farm. On rules/events.mjs since 2026-10-31 (was `cooldowns.shouchao_h` and `play_pay.tide`); a save counted before keeps its clock (shouchao.mjs withClock).

qiecuo._about: 比武切磋 (rules/qiecuo.mjs; Hanli 2026-10-28: 「冷却3小时」): a bout comes again `every_h` after the last was over — won, lost or put down; a bout won pays its 体力 × the formula (master.xiuwei, 2026-11-02) × ★, the day's first `full` in full, then play_pay.replay's share; 灵石 as a 格斗 board (play_pay.wealth).

yaoshou._about: 妖兽出没 (rules/yaoshou.mjs): one fight a batch since 2026-11-02 (Hanli: 「降妖等也是, 都一局就可以了」; was 3). Agent's pick (Hanli delegated 11-02): `batch` 1, so `fight_scale` derives to 1 (master `batch_plays` 1 ÷ 1) — the one fight pays what the batch of three paid together; `every_h` 1.5 and `full` 2 kept, so a day's 降妖 pay is as before (a shorter wait would raise it). Fewer fights a day: the 秘境令's `mijing.key.drops.yaoshou` (0.2 a win) now comes a third as often.

open.zh: 后山和上山路一带，又有妖兽出没了。
open.en: Beasts are abroad again on the back hill and the mountain road.

shut.zh: 山里的妖兽才被打退，一时不敢再下来。
shut.en: The beasts were only just driven back; they will not come down again for a while.

_pills: 丹药 (design.md § 丹药; batch 2, Hanli 2026-11-10: 「丹药, 物品都给一个级别吧, 算数值的时候, 按照这个级别算」 · 「回春族按你说的改，筑基丹份额高一档」): every pill its `level`, its 阶 (`tier`) and its 转 (items.json); a pill of a family (`of`) carries what master.pills makes of it at its level (`effects`, tools/master.mjs pillsOf; content.mjs withBalance folds it on): 聚气 · 筑基 · 固基 their 修为 (share × need(level), as units at R of the level — never where he eats it, never `below`), 回春 its heal and 回气 its mana in a fight, the 九转回春丹 its declared exception beside its heal. Breakthrough pills (ladder.json breakthrough.pill.items) are read by the throw by their 转; their 修为 (eaten) is their family's.
_dandu: 丹毒 and 补转 (story DESIGN § 六·五: 下品吃多了积毒，体力上限一时降低，闭关可排；上品无毒；九转反能化毒). A 修为 pill eaten (服用 from the pouch, the 闭关 pill, a breakthrough's pill) leaves the turns its furnace left out owing: `owed` by 转 (一转 8 — the nine a 九转 has, less the one it got; 中品 四至六转 看体质, none in 卷一; 上品 none). Each turn owed takes `per_turn` off the 体力 pool's top, `cap` at most (state.mjs staminaMax). 闭关 is 补转 — the body makes up `cure_per_hour` turns an hour of any focus (rules/seclusion.mjs). A pill of `clears` 转 or more clears every turn owed. Fight pills (the 丹囊's 回春丹 · 回气丹) owe nothing for now (Hanli's call: 灵石 buys them, and 丹毒 there would tax the 灵石 once 体力 is on). With these numbers a 聚气丹 a day is made up by one hour's sitting; four at once stand at the cap until a night's 闭关.
_model: The players tools/balance.mjs plays, day by day (design.md § Pacing: ~30 minutes a day, one 回 a week; 古一–古三 fast). `minutes`: what each thing takes (a scene's passages read at `chars_per_min`). `players`: minutes a day (the first day longer), sittings, and what each does daily — `gongke` the share of days the 功课 is handed in, `walls` the share of a day's 执事堂 east-wall tags taken in the routine (2026-10-27, doc/gates-2026-10-27.md: the typical player one of the three; every player takes the rest while a gate holds him), `fights` pool fights, `fantong` feeds, `tale` 今日传闻s, `gate_fights` more pool fights while a stage quest waits, `seclude` hours of 闭关 a night (focus 修为: rewards.json seclusion's rate, the seclusion table's cap). `fight_win_rate`: a fight won (the 斗法 band, played again when lost). `fantong_units`: a feed's 修为 on average, in units at R (a pill now and then: 3 at 练气一层). `errands_at`: the 回 each errand that pays 修为 or a pill is done in (null: on no 卷一 map; tests/balance.test.mjs makes a new one name its 回). `fit`: the player and the days --fit aims the stage quests at (the heavy player: the one they hold back); `bands`: what the test holds, for the 回s from `later` on. Guesses to be hand-played on the live page (Hanli). `waking_h`: the waking day the sittings spread over, for 体力 — the model plays it ON (rewards.json stamina), as players will have it (on in play since 2026-11-02, at testing numbers), and with these players it never binds.

model._practice: 2026-10-27 (pay as a share of the layer): while a stage quest holds the way, the minutes left after the pool's fights go to practice boards — `minutes` a board, `factor` for its ★ (≈0.8) and the replay's falling share over a sitting (≈0.75).
model._minutes_tide: `tide`: a night of 兽潮 as the model plays it, about 3 minutes — the kits' measured 1–5 (2026-11-04, tests/fixtures/play-minutes.json; was 5, agent's pick 11-02). The rules charge a night its kit's own minutes (rewards.json stamina.cost.shouchao `board`); `fight` 2: a card fight as measured (was 4).
model._fight_games: 2026-10-28: a story board played as a fight (格斗: the 秦雁 bouts, tools/balance.mjs bookWalk) takes a fight's minutes and retries, not a board's — it stands where a card fight stood (09-futian).
model._session: 2026-10-27 (Hanli at 古五's 渡口, 129/498: 「渡口前应该让玩家接近2层圆满」): the playtest player — the book straight through in long sittings, no nights between, no 功课, no 闭关, no wall tags but while a gate holds him (balance.mjs playWalls). The gate rule (master hours.fit `arrive`) holds the 修为 a one-layer gate asks to be about earned by the time he reaches it; never in the bands.
model._story_stars: The story's own boards, played on the way: each pays its play pay (its minutes at the layer, rules/playpay.mjs) at this ★ (2 = 0.8), on top of its task's grant (数值系统 phase 2: they had been counted for their grant alone).

bands._except: Since 2026-10-16 the story raises no layer: every 层 is ground. With `layer_pay` (修为 by the layer) every 回 from 古四 sits in the one typical band, 5–7.5 days — save 古五 (h07), allowed down to 4.5: the smooth curve keeps 二层 cheap so 古六's two layers fit (see `_layer_pay`). Lowered to 4 on 2026-10-16: the boards cut before 入门 (Hanli 「减少数量, 推动剧情」) shorten the opening, and 古五 lands 4.3 typical days. 2026-10-26: with the book's full text, 古四 (h05) reads 7.7 typical days and 古六 (h08) 10.1 — allowed to 8 and 10.5 until the new small games land and the 层 are re-fit (fit._hold). 2026-10-26 (全文后的小游戏 第二批): 古六's nine new boards add their minutes to the light player (19 → 22 days); its light band allowed to 24, its typical to 11, its heavy to 6.5 while fit._hold keeps 古四–古六 at 470…530. 第八回 (h09)'s three boards (考书 · 用哪颗丹 · 恬惔虚无) lift its typical 7.1 → 7.8, and 今四's six (it rides with 古八) to 8.1: allowed to 8.5, the same hold. 2026-10-27 (pay as a share of the layer, play_pay): a fight won pays its minutes of play (练气四层 ≈ 12, was 30 × layer_pay 3 = 90), so this model — which plays fights, 闭关, the 功课 and, held at a stage quest, practice boards (`practice`) — runs 古六–古八 long (typical 13 · 10.1 · 12.6 days); the bands are widened to what it prints until the 层 are re-fit or the practice share is played in full (doc/games.md § Pay as a share of the layer). 2026-10-27 (数值系统 phase 2): the hours are fitted to the bands (master.lines.gu.hours.fit), so 古六–古八 (h08 · h11 · h09) are back in the one band and their widenings are gone; 古五's light player reads 7.9 days with the rerun run only while it raises him — its light band from 7.5. 古七 (h11) reads 4.5 typical days on the curve's 五–六层 (4 · 4.5 h): dearer layers would stretch it into 5–7.5 only by keeping him at 09-futian's gate (Hanli 10-27: no gate may keep him where there is little to do) — allowed from 4 until its book is longer. 2026-10-28 (妖兽出没: a batch of 3 fights pays as one, and the 层 refit by numbers --apply): 古七 (h11)'s light player reads 7.9 days — allowed from 7.5, as 古五's. 2026-11-04 (the 年 pools read through their boards, Hanli 「可以, 按你说的做」 · 「攒修为可以让玩家去后山打怪吧?」): 古八 (h09) keeps ten of its twenty pool boards (four · three · three), and its typical player reads 4.9 days (was 5.5) — he stands 圆满 at 09-shenshi already, so a smaller gate lump changes nothing for him (tried: 570/660 → 450/520 moves 4.9 → 5.0), and dearer layers would only keep him at the gates (numbers --apply: 「kept at the curve」). His 修为 between beats is the haunts' (后山崖顶's 降妖, 上山路's 妖兽出没, 兽潮, 切磋), never more story boards — allowed from 4.5, as 古七's. 2026-11-04 (体力 by play time, Hanli 「小游戏有一些时间比较长的」 · 「剧情保持不扣」): a story step costs nothing and a board its measured minutes (most 1–3, was 3), so the typical sitting's 体力 lasts longer and 古五 (h07) reads 3.9 typical days (was 4.1), 古八 (h09) 4.4 (4.9) — allowed from 3.5 and 4, and 古八's light player (6.7 days, was 11.9 — not traced yet; to look at in the re-fit) from 6, until the 层 are re-fit on the new costs. 2026-11-09 (no free 修为, Hanli: 「不要白给修为…」 · 「剧情可以给修为, 但要给的和玩一场小游戏差不多」): the untold `gate` lumps (wm-yaoyuan 210, 09-suifeng 430, 09-nianyao 500, 09-dabi 570) became one small game's pay, so 古四 (h05) reads 8.9 typical days (light 24.2), 古七 (h11) 13 (light 48.3, heavy 8.6), 古八 (h09) 12.7 (light 34.6, heavy 6.8): widened to what the model prints, NOT retuned — the pay tables and the 层 are Hanli's call (doc/status.md 11-09). 2026-11-10 (the curve, Hanli: 「所有和数值相关的都应该有公式推到」; the lumps 660 · 750 now story steps; T₁ solved by tools/balance.mjs --solve): 古四 (h05) and 古七 (h11)'s typical and heavy are back in the one band, their rows gone; kept — 古五 (h07) typical from 3.5: the told 760 (master.xiuwei.told, wm-mingpai) fills 二层 at the 石室's door, so the 秘境 is its reading (3.9 at T₁ 3.57; 7.1 at T₁ 5; 16.1 typical with the 760 a story step instead), and 古七's light from 7.5 to 49: the light player sits no 闭关, and 古七 holds two 层 (26 days). 古八 (h09) keeps the 11-09 row unwidened and stands OUT of it (typical 14.4, light 45, heavy 8): it holds three 层 (七 · 八 · 九) in one 回 with one scene before 七层's gate and none between 七层's and 八层's — no T₁ and no smooth curve brings three layers into one band, and a pin cheap enough would ask less of 七层 than of 六层. Hanli's call (doc: the 11-10 report). 2026-11-10 evening (the games carry the layer — master.xiuwei._board; 九节菖蒲 and the red tags in 七–九层; T₁ re-solved on each 回's own band, tools/balance.mjs --solve): 古八 is inside its own row now (typical 12.5, light 23, heavy 5.0), still over the one band — three 层 in one 回, and h11 binds T₁ from the other side (7.0 typical at T₁ 1.564); its row stays, unwidened. 2026-11-12 (修为不要超过上限, 超过后换算为灵石奖励 — Hanli; rules/cap.mjs landProgress): 修为 past the cap is 灵石 now, never carried into the next layer or banked, so 古七 (h11) reads 8.3 typical days (was 7.0): widened to 8.5, and 古八 (h09) 13.2 (was 12.3): its row to 13.5, NOT retuned — Hanli's call (卷一 typical 45 → 50 days).

model._pills: 灵石 out (2026-10-16): the pills a player carries into a fight and eats — `pills` per fight a player, bought at the mean shelf price of `pills_bought`, only with what he has (tools/balance.mjs --wealth prints the flow).

_play_pay: Every 修为 pay is a share of the layer he stands on (Hanli 2026-10-27: 「12分钟的一个小游戏占2个小时的10%, 所以要奖励10%的修为」, then 「一层才要470修为, 我们可否按照百分比奖励, 这样等级高了后, 奖励也合理」; doc/games.md § Pay as a share of the layer; rules/playpay.mjs). A layer is a play-time budget (`hours`, derived since 2026-10-27: the master table's curve — 练气一层 2 h, +0.5 h a layer; 筑基 4 h, +2 h a realm — with the layers a 回 holds fitted to its band and 古五's 渡口 to the gate rule, master.mjs fitHours). The small games and fights carry `games.share` (60%) of its 修为 over `games.time` (35%) of its minutes: a board of m minutes pays m ÷ (0.35 × the layer's minutes) × 60% of the layer's need — 练气一层 a 1-minute board 1.4% (7), a 6-minute 棋牌 8.6% (40) at 2 h; a fight won (`haunt`) its `fight.minutes`. ★ 0.6 · 0.8 · 1.0; the same board again the same day 100 · 50 · 10%. Errands: 15% of the layer over 10% of its time, by `errand.minutes` (练气一层 6.3%, 29). 人间功课 (`chore`): a day's 10%, a week's 20%, a month's 30% of the layer (练气一层 47 · 94 · 141; Hanli 2026-10-27: 「cfo倒入账单应该是每月任务」 — rarer, so more), no ★, no replay. What the book authors — a scene's way on, a pill, a rumor, a 机缘, the tables in `authored.tables` — is read as a share of the 练气一层 it was written against (`authored.base` 470: a scene's 60 is 12.8%). 灵石 stays by the kind and the tables. No daily cap; 修为 stops at the gate and turns to 灵石 (`convert` lists `play` and `haunt`). Supersedes the per-layer `rate` tables and `layer_pay` for fights (2026-10-27).

play_pay._minutes: A board's minutes, by its kind (games.json `mechanic`): its 体力 (rewards.json stamina.cost.game `board`, state.mjs boardCost; 1 体力 ≈ 1 分钟) and so its 修为 (R × 体力, rules/playpay.mjs). _fight_length: How long a card fight may run (Hanli 2026-11-07: 「斗法敌人100多血，攻击牌攻击一般都几点，一局要玩快10分钟。能控制在3分钟吗」 — then: about 3 minutes at today's 练气, longer with more cards and higher realms but within about 5, Hearthstone's match length; a boss within the same 5). A CEILING, not a target: a fight already shorter stays as it is. `minutes` by the ladder's tier index (练气, 筑基, 结丹, 元婴, then `cap`); `sec_per_round` turns rounds (his turn and the beast's) into minutes — measured on his recording, 当康 at 古七 (101 气血, two heals): about 5 minutes, which the rules play in about 16 rounds (≈150 logged moves, his "157 plays"), so ≈18.6 s a round. The door (rules/cards.mjs fightLength) caps a beast's 气血 at `dpt` × the realm's rounds, where `dpt` is what a player of that level deals a round (since batch 3, 2026-11-10, derived from master.fight.length: `dpt.first` card points at 练气一层 + `dpt.per_level` a level, over the realm's length class — 练气's old rows to the point, 筑基一层 6.54 for 6.5, 二 · 三层 7.0 · 7.46 for 6.8 · 7.1; until then `base` by tier index + `step` a 层, fitted on the road's hands, tools/fight-length.mjs; the party beside him adds next to none: 阿禾 heals, 孙二狗 guards), the 气血 it loses coming back on its blows (`carry`: its blows × (old 气血 ÷ new)^carry, so the fight is as hard, only shorter), and lets it heal `heals` times a fight, never more than one round's `dpt` (battle.js § heal). Not capped: a 试 (creatures.json `trial`: outlasted, its 气血 does not set its length) and a fight whose foe says `long: true` (a story fight the plot wants long — none today). tests/fight-length.test.mjs plays every fight of 卷一 and fails one too long for its realm.
